name: Good AI Tools

sources.title: Good AI Tools homepage — AI tools directory with Submit nav link
Submit page — redirects to login wall ('Log in to Submit')
Get Started page — sign-in required before submitting

requirements: Product should be an AI tool (directory is organised entirely around AI categories)
An account is mandatory: /submit shows 'Log in to Submit' with Google sign-in or email account creation
preparation: Logo image (all listings show a logo tile)
Pricing model label used on the site: Free, Freemium, Free Trial, or Paid
Best-fit category from their taxonomy (AI Assistants, Dev Tools, Content Creation, etc.)
A Google account or email for registration
workflow: Create an account via /signup or 'Log in with Google' (/api/auth/google?redirect=/submit)
Fill the submission form (fields not visible without an account)
Submit and wait for the listing to be reviewed/published
watchFor: The 'Submit' nav link and /submit URL both land on a login wall — no guest submission
A persistent third-party ad banner ('We Submit Your SaaS to 140+ Directories' → submitsaas.com) is a paid directory-submission service, not part of this site
No public pricing or review-time information was found on reachable pages
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool page under goodaitools.com with the product name, logo, description, category tag and a Visit link, visible in Latest or its category listing
unknowns: Whether submission is free, freemium, or paid — no pricing page was reachable
Form fields behind the login wall
